description: The District Health Management Team has requested improvements to the patient search workflow to handle duplicate names better. Using the DHIS2 Maintenance app (login: admin / district), modify the 'Child Programme' configuration. Specifically, update the program's Enrollment/Attribute settings so that the 'Gender' (or Sex) and 'Address' (or Village/City) attributes are visible in the search results list (Display in list). Do not remove existing columns, just ensure these two are enabled.
